workPackages.subject: Phase 1 Refinement: CMS Tri-Platform & Auth-Gating
workPackages.description: Ekspansi Phase 1 untuk Web Sekota: Implementasi CMS Pengelola (Desktop, Android, CLI), Image File Upload, Cross-Platform Sync, Dynamic Book Details & Metadata Enrichment, and Inline Auth-Gating Modal Dialog.

workPackages.subject: UC-GATE-01: Implement Inline Auth Modal Dialog in Web Sekota
workPackages.description: Mengimplementasikan AuthGateDialog pada BookDetailsScreen dan MerchandiseScreen untuk memvalidasi login sebelum Read/Download atau Order.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-01: Implement Shared Domain & Repository for Admin Books & Tools
workPackages.description: Menyambungkan shared KMP ke endpoint /admin/books, /admin/tools, ClientInquiry, LiveMetrics, Cross-Platform SyncService, serta Book Web Metadata Enrichment (rating, category, pdfUrl, readerCount).

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-02: Implement Kotlin Admin CLI (sekota-cli)
workPackages.description: Menyediakan command line interface berbasis Kotlin untuk administrasi katalog buku (list, add, delete), produk, dan merchandise.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-03: Implement Compose Desktop JVM & Android Admin Window
workPackages.description: Membangun antarmuka visual admin di Compose Desktop & Android untuk memantau Intelligence Suite, Books Metadata Enrichment Dialog, Merchandise, Live Metrics, Konsultasi Masuk, serta image upload file picker.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-04: Implement Products & Merchandise Management Integration
workPackages.description: Integrasi CRUD produk Intelligence Suite (Veridia, Ascendio, Sociara, Ecoflow), Merchandise store dengan file picker image upload, serta dynamic cross-sync ke Web & Dynamic Book Details viewer.
